covers: Structured Mind tasks of kinds research-plan, upstream-impact, pr-triage, adoption-draft and progress-report for the listed projects
Opening research-question issues in Blockchains/sol-college from Mind proposals that pass deterministic checks (at most one per project per run)
Dispatching candidate-validation for new open lab pull-request heads
Building adoption packages for candidates whose newest genuine validation run passed
Publishing the Lab Reporter status (checked text) to records/public/status

Structured experiment-patch tasks: a Mind's unified-diff patch, after the deterministic patch gate (size, path allowlist, no .github/workflow/toolchain/manifest edits, no secrets) and gitleaks, is applied by lab-patch to a fresh branch sc-lab/<project>/<task> on the project's lab fork (never main, never upstream), validated by the secret-free candidate-validation workflow, and opened as a lab PR on the fork when SC_LAB_PR_TOKEN is configured
Upstream pull requests for fixes whose exact candidate passed validation: one focused PR per project at a time, after a duplicate check (needs a token with upstream PR rights; see docs/autonomy.md)

Devnet lab treasury transfers requested by a Mind (devnet-treasury workflow): no per-request cap, no per-project daily cap, no recipient allowlist (owner instruction t688u); devnet only, key only as a protected secret, append-only ledger of every transaction
Publishing each Mind's operations snapshot (cognition balance and usage, usage by tool, equipped skills and apps, conversation count) to records/public/minds

Auto-acceptance by owner policy (t690u, 2026-11-15): project-acceptance accepts a package with no human comment when candidate-validation passed on the exact candidate commit, the package exists, its sha256 matches the recomputed hash and the candidate matches; recorded as 'auto-accepted by owner policy (2026-11-15, user instruction)', then the certificate is issued and the campus republished
excludes: Mainnet: any non-devnet cluster is rejected before signing; mainnet keys are never used
Giving any Mind a private key
Pushes to main or to upstream repositories (upstream changes only as pull requests)
Manual acceptance on anyone's behalf: the agent never posts /sc-accept
